items.summary: Recommendation: approve only the three isolated preview-only scaffold changes, with no publication, analytics activation, affiliate setup, deployment, or external spend. Reject revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, budget, causal-lift, and forecast claims. For the 30-day window pulled 2026-10-02, Amazon reports 5.20 commission, 5,992 clicks, 31 ordered items, and 7 shipped items; all commission is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue and margin are unsupported. AI usage for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 is $54.5828597 across 359 calls with 22 errors; only 28 of 40 expected sites are instrumented. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and AI costs are not period-aligned, AI allocation is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and labor rates are absent, and no monthly budgets are provided. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content revenue, registered tracking IDs, complete AI ledger coverage, infrastructure/domain invoices, labor-cost basis, and approved budget limits. Preview QA and readiness completion are learning outputs, not financial returns.
